Latin word

afferō

afferō, afferre, attulī, allātum

verb, irregular (ad + ferō) · Conjugation on Wiktionary

bring (a thing); bring on, cause (pain, worry, delay); bring; fetch, bring (a thing); bring with it, cause; bring forward, adduce (a reason, an example)

    the recommended word · classical · Catull. 13.3–4: sī tēcum attuleris bonam atque magnam cēnam; Plin. Ep. 4.30.1: attulī tibi ex patriā meā prō mūnusculō quaestiōnem; Traupman 283; Traupman 389
